title: Comparison of Silevimig, a Novel Bispecific Anti-Rabies Monoclonal Antibody, with Human Rabies Immunoglobulin for Post-Exposure Prophylaxis: A Phase III, Randomized, Double-Blind, Non-Inferiority Trial.
abstract: Abstracts This phase III randomized, double-blind, non-inferiority trial evaluated Silevimig, a bispecific anti-rabies monoclonal antibody targeting antigenic sites I and III, as a substitute for human rabies immunoglobulin (HRIG) in post-exposure prophylaxis. Adults (>18 years) with suspected WHO category III rabies exposure were randomly assigned (3:1) to receive Silevimig or HRIG. After wound cleansing, the study drug was administered on day 0, together with a rabies vaccine given on days 0, 3, 7, 14, and 28. The co-primary endpoints were the adjusted geometric mean concentration (GMC) of rabies virus–neutralizing antibodies (RVNAs) on day 7, the proportion of participants with an RVNA level of ≥ 0.5 IU/mL (seroresponse) by day 14, and the rabies-free survival rate in 1 year (D365). Safety was assessed through adverse events (AEs) and serious adverse events (SAEs). A total of 1,200 participants were enrolled. On day 7, the adjusted GMC of RVNAs was 0.40 IU/mL in the Silevimig group versus 0.36 IU/mL in the HRIG group, meeting the non-inferiority criterion (ratio 1.11; 95% CI: 1.01–1.21). Seroresponse rates on days 14 and 90 were slightly higher with Silevimig. No rabies cases occurred during the 1-year follow-up, yielding a 100% rabies-free survival rate in both groups. Most AEs were mild to moderate. Silevimig was non-inferior to HRIG in inducing early RVNA responses, was well tolerated, and did not interfere with vaccine-induced immunity. These findings support Silevimig as a safe and effective alternative for passive rabies post-exposure prophylaxis (ClinicalTrials, NCT05846568).

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估一种新型双特异性抗狂犬病单克隆抗体Silevimig,作为暴露后预防中人狂犬病免疫球蛋白(HRIG)的替代品,以满足狂犬病预防中替代治疗的需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本项III期、随机、双盲、非劣效性试验在疑似WHO III类狂犬病暴露的成年人(>18岁)中进行,共纳入1,200名受试者,并按3:1的比例随机分配接受Silevimig或HRIG治疗。
elements_zh.methods: 安全性通过不良事件(AEs)和严重不良事件(SAEs)进行评估,同时研究评估了第7天调整后的狂犬病病毒中和抗体(RVNAs)几何平均浓度(GMC)以及第14天达到血清反应的受试者比例。
elements_zh.main_results: 第7天,Silevimig组的调整后RVNAs GMC为0.40 IU/mL,HRIG组为0.36 IU/mL,满足非劣效性标准(比值1.11;95% CI:1.01–1.21)。1年随访期间未发生狂犬病病例,两组均达到100%的无狂犬病生存率。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,Silevimig在诱导早期RVNA反应方面与HRIG非劣效,且耐受性良好,不影响疫苗诱导的免疫反应。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果表明,Silevimig可能是一种安全有效的被动狂犬病 暴露后预防替代方案,可能有助于改善狂犬病预防的治疗选择。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究设计良好,但研究结果的普遍性可能受限于特定人群和环境,且由于采用非劣效性试验设计和完整的随访,证据强度较强。

analysis_en.methods: Safety was assessed through adverse events (AEs) and serious adverse events (SAEs), while the study evaluated the adjusted geometric mean concentration (GMC) of rabies virus–neutralizing antibodies (RVNAs) on day 7 and the proportion of participants achieving seroresponse by day 14.
analysis_en.main_results: On day 7, the adjusted GMC of RVNAs was 0.40 IU/mL in the Silevimig group versus 0.36 IU/mL in the HRIG group, meeting the non-inferiority criterion (ratio 1.11; 95% CI: 1.01–1.21). No rabies cases occurred during the 1-year follow-up, yielding a 100% rabies-free survival rate in both groups.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that Silevimig was non-inferior to HRIG in inducing early RVNA responses and was well tolerated, without interfering with vaccine-induced immunity.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest that Silevimig could be a safe and effective alternative for passive rabies post-exposure prophylaxis, potentially improving treatment options for rabies prevention.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was well conducted, but the generalizability of results may be limited to the specific population and setting, and the evidence is strong due to the non-inferiority trial design and complete follow-up.

title_zh: 一种新型双特异性抗狂犬病单克隆抗体Silevimig与人狂犬病免疫球蛋白在暴露后预防中的比较:一项III期、随机、双盲、非劣效性试验。
source_body_en: Abstracts This phase III randomized, double-blind, non-inferiority trial evaluated Silevimig, a bispecific anti-rabies monoclonal antibody targeting antigenic sites I and III, as a substitute for human rabies immunoglobulin (HRIG) in post-exposure prophylaxis. Adults (>18 years) with suspected WHO category III rabies exposure were randomly assigned (3:1) to receive Silevimig or HRIG. After wound cleansing, the study drug was administered on day 0, together with a rabies vaccine given on days 0, 3, 7, 14, and 28. The co-primary endpoints were the adjusted geometric mean concentration (GMC) of rabies virus–neutralizing antibodies (RVNAs) on day 7, the proportion of participants with an RVNA level of ≥ 0.5 IU/mL (seroresponse) by day 14, and the rabies-free survival rate in 1 year (D365). Safety was assessed through adverse events (AEs) and serious adverse events (SAEs). A total of 1,200 participants were enrolled. On day 7, the adjusted GMC of RVNAs was 0.40 IU/mL in the Silevimig group versus 0.36 IU/mL in the HRIG group, meeting the non-inferiority criterion (ratio 1.11; 95% CI: 1.01–1.21). Seroresponse rates on days 14 and 90 were slightly higher with Silevimig. No rabies cases occurred during the 1-year follow-up, yielding a 100% rabies-free survival rate in both groups. Most AEs were mild to moderate. Silevimig was non-inferior to HRIG in inducing early RVNA responses, was well tolerated, and did not interfere with vaccine-induced immunity. These findings support Silevimig as a safe and effective alternative for passive rabies post-exposure prophylaxis (ClinicalTrials, NCT05846568).
abstract_zh: 摘要 本项III期、随机、双盲、非劣效性试验评估了Silevimig,一种针对抗原位点I和III的双特异性抗狂犬病单克隆抗体,作为暴露后预防中人狂犬病免疫球蛋白(HRIG)的替代品。纳入研究的受试者为疑似WHO III类狂犬病暴露的成年人(>18岁),按3:1的比例随机分配接受Silevimig或HRIG治疗。在伤口清洁后,研究药物于第0天给予,同时在第0、3、7、14和28天给予狂犬病 疫苗。主要终点包括第7天调整后的狂犬病病毒中和抗体(RVNAs)几何平均浓度(GMC)、第14天RVNA水平≥0.5 IU/mL(血清反应)的受试者比例,以及1年无狂犬病生存率(D365)。安全性通过不良事件(AEs)和严重不良事件(SAEs)进行评估。共纳入1,200名受试者。第7天,Silevimig组的调整后RVNAs GMC为0.40 IU/mL,HRIG组为0.36 IU/mL,满足非劣效性标准(比值1.11;95% CI:1.01–1.21)。Silevimig在第14天和第90天的血清反应率略高。1年随访期间未发生狂犬病病例,两组均达到100%的无狂犬病生存率。大多数不良事件为轻度至中度。Silevimig在诱导早期RVNA反应方面与HRIG非劣效,耐受性良好,且不影响疫苗诱导的免疫反应。这些结果支持Silevimig作为被动狂犬病 暴露后预防的可行安全有效替代方案(临床试验,NCT05846568)。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估一种新型双特异性抗狂犬病单克隆抗体Silevimig,作为暴露后预防中人狂犬病免疫球蛋白(HRIG)的替代品,以满足狂犬病预防中替代治疗的需求。

title: Phylogenetic analysis of rabies virus isolates recovered in the Novosibirsk Oblast (the Russian Federation)
abstract: The Novosibirsk Oblast is classified as a rabies-endemic region within the Siberian Federal District of the Russian Federation, ranking first in the number of reported cases among all constituent territories of the district. However, there is a notable lack of research on the genetic properties of the rabies virus field isolates. This study seeks to assess how rabies outbreaks in the rabies endemic Novosibirsk Oblast are connected with those in the neighbouring regions, by analyzing genetic diversity of rabies virus variants and their spatial distribution. Materials and methods . Two overlapping genome fragments containing full-size nucleoprotein (N) gene of rabies virus were Sanger-sequenced following purification, using a previously established procedure. Phylogenetic analysis was performed using a Bayesian approach as implemented in the Bayesian Evolutionary Analysis Sampling Trees (BEAST Х) software package. The number of registered animal rabies cases after 2012 declined markedly and has not exceeded 60 cases per year. All the studied isolates belong to genetic group C. The isolates are classified into two genetic clusters – C2c (35 isolates) and C2b (18 isolates). One of the rabies virus isolates was recovered in mouse neuroblastoma cell culture. All group C clusters found in the Novosibirsk Oblast have previously been reported in Kazakhstan as well. The most stable connections are observed within the East Kazakhstan (Сlusters C2c, C1b) and North Kazakhstan (Сlusters C2c, C2b) Oblasts. Results of the phylogenetic analysis are consistent with earlier descriptions of “fox” rabies and with the findings of epizootiological monitoring in adjacent territories of Western Siberia and Kazakhstan. At present, two independently derived virus clusters – C2b and C2c – are circulating in the Novosibirsk Oblast.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解新西伯利亚州狂犬病病毒毒株的遗传多样性及其与邻近地区暴发的关联,因为目前对于狂犬病病毒现场分离株的遗传特性研究仍存在显著不足。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了新西伯利亚州的狂犬病病毒毒株,该州被归类为俄罗斯联邦西伯利亚联邦区内的狂犬病流行区,其报告病例数量在该区所有组成部分中居首。2012年后注册的动物狂犬病病例数量显著下降,且每年未超过60例。
elements_zh.methods: 采用已建立的程序,对经过纯化的包含狂犬病病毒全长核蛋白(N)基因的两个重叠基因组片段进行Sanger测序。系统发育分析使用贝叶斯方法,通过贝叶斯进化分析采样树(BEAST Х)软件包实施。
elements_zh.main_results: 在新西伯利亚州发现的所有遗传组C簇此前均已在哈萨克斯坦被报道。这些毒株被分为两个遗传簇——C2c(35株)和C2b(18株)。系统发育分析的结果与之前对“狐狸”狂犬病的描述一致,并与西伯利亚西部和哈萨克斯坦相邻地区的流行病学监测结果相符。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,新西伯利亚州的狂犬病病毒毒株在遗传上与哈萨克斯坦的毒株相关,且结果与之前对“狐狸”狂犬病的描述及相邻地区的流行病学监测数据一致。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 本研究提供了关于狂犬病病毒在新西伯利亚州的遗传多样性和空间分布的见解,有助于该地区及邻近地区的监测防控策略制定。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于仅关注遗传分析而缺乏详细的流行病学数据,且证据强度中等,因为它依赖于已建立的程序和与其他地区的比较。

Materials and methods . Two overlapping genome fragments containing full-size nucleoprotein (N) gene of rabies virus were Sanger-sequenced following purification, using a previously established procedure. Phylogenetic analysis was performed using a Bayesian approach as implemented in the Bayesian Evolutionary Analysis Sampling Trees (BEAST Х) software package. The number of registered animal rabies cases after 2012 declined markedly and has not exceeded 60 cases per year. All the studied isolates belong to genetic group C. The isolates are classified into two genetic clusters – C2c (35 isolates) and C2b (18 isolates). One of the rabies virus isolates was recovered in mouse neuroblastoma cell culture. All group C clusters found in the Novosibirsk Oblast have previously been reported in Kazakhstan as well. The most stable connections are observed within the East Kazakhstan (Сlusters C2c, C1b) and North Kazakhstan (Сlusters C2c, C2b) Oblasts. Results of the phylogenetic analysis are consistent with earlier descriptions of “fox” rabies and with the findings of epizootiological monitoring in adjacent territories of Western Siberia and Kazakhstan. At present, two independently derived virus clusters – C2b and C2c – are circulating in the Novosibirsk Oblast.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解新西伯利亚州狂犬病病毒毒株的遗传多样性及其与邻近地区暴发的关联,因为目前对于狂犬病病毒现场分离株的遗传特性研究仍存在显著不足。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究分析了新西伯利亚州的狂犬病病毒毒株,该州被归类为俄罗斯联邦西伯利亚联邦区内的狂犬病流行区,其报告病例数量在该区所有组成部分中居首。2012年后注册的动物狂犬病病例数量显著下降,且每年未超过60例。
analysis_zh.methods: 采用已建立的程序,对经过纯化的包含狂犬病病毒全长核蛋白(N)基因的两个重叠基因组片段进行Sanger测序。系统发育分析使用贝叶斯方法,通过贝叶斯进化分析采样树(BEAST Х)软件包实施。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在新西伯利亚州发现的所有遗传组C簇此前均已在哈萨克斯坦被报道。这些毒株被分为两个遗传簇——C2c(35株)和C2b(18株)。系统发育分析的结果与之前对“狐狸”狂犬病的描述一致,并与西伯利亚西部和哈萨克斯坦相邻地区的流行病学监测结果相符。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,新西伯利亚州的狂犬病病毒毒株在遗传上与哈萨克斯坦的毒株相关,且结果与之前对“狐狸”狂犬病的描述及相邻地区的流行病学监测数据一致。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 本研究提供了关于狂犬病病毒在新西伯利亚州的遗传多样性和空间分布的见解,有助于该地区及邻近地区的监测防控策略制定。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于仅关注遗传分析而缺乏详细的流行病学数据,且证据强度中等,因为它依赖于已建立的程序和与其他地区的比较。

title: Development of a test system for detection of the rabies virus genome using real-time PCR with an endogenous control: Theoretical design and optimization
abstract: Although rabies incidence in Russia has decreased over the past ten years, it still remains a highly relevant disease. Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) in its various modifications is one of the tools for detecting and characterizing rabies virus in pathological samples. To ensure reliable diagnosis, the current data on genetic properties of the isolates circulating in particular area should be considered when developing PCR. Providing a theoretical foundation and optimizing the test system based on combined reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (C-RT-PCR) for the detection of a rabies virus genome fragment using endogenous internal control. Materials and methods. Rabies virus vaccine strain “RV-97” and laboratory fixed rabies virus strain “CVS”, brain samples from animals of various species, both rabies virus positive and negative, were used in the work. Oligonucleotide design and in silico specificity testing were performed using Primer Blast online tool. Syntol reagents (Russia) were used for C-RT-PCR. As a result of the analysis of 193 N-gene sequences of rabies virus isolates circulating in Russia and neighboring countries, six primers and two TaqMan probes were designed. Two primers and a probe, optimal for the development of the test system, were experimentally identified. During a series of experiments, C-RT-PCR parameters such as oligonucleotide and magnesium ion concentrations, as well as annealing temperature were optimized. To control the reaction conditions in each tube, an oligonucleotide system was developed for the amplification and detection of the mammalian beta-actin gene region. The possibility of simultaneous application of two PCR systems in one test tube has been experimentally demonstrated. Analysis of 193 N-gene sequences of various rabies virus isolates showed that the developed oligonucleotides can theoretically ensure detection of the vast majority of the viruses circulating in the Russian Federation and neighboring countries. The main components and reaction conditions of the test system for detecting the rabies virus genome by C-RT-PCR using mammalian beta-actin gene-based endogenous internal control have been developed and optimized.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to develop a reliable test system for detecting the rabies virus genome using real-time PCR with an endogenous control, addressing the need for improved diagnostic methods in rabies surveillance.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved the development and optimization of a test system based on combined reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (C-RT-PCR) using brain samples from animals of various species, both rabies virus positive and negative.
analysis.methods: The methods included the design of six primers and two TaqMan probes based on 193 N-gene sequences of rabies virus isolates, optimization of C-RT-PCR parameters such as oligonucleotide and magnesium ion concentrations, and annealing temperature. An endogenous internal control system was also developed for amplification and detection of the mammalian beta-actin gene region.
analysis.main_results: Analysis of 193 N-gene sequences showed that the developed oligonucleotides can theoretically ensure detection of the vast majority of the viruses circulating in the Russian Federation and neighboring countries.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as demonstrating the feasibility of using an endogenous control in C-RT-PCR for rabies virus detection, which represents a novel approach to improving diagnostic reliability.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of more accurate and reliable diagnostic tools for rabies virus surveillance, which is critical for public health and disease control efforts.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to theoretical design and optimization, with no direct experimental validation of the test system's performance. The evidence is moderate as it is based on sequence analysis and experimental demonstration of the method's potential.

analysis.summary_en: This study focuses on developing a test system for detecting the rabies virus genome using real-time PCR with an endogenous control. The research addresses the need for improved diagnostic methods in rabies surveillance, particularly in the Russian Federation and neighboring countries. The theoretical design and optimization of the combined reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (C-RT-PCR) system involved analyzing 193 N-gene sequences of rabies virus isolates to design six primers and two TaqMan probes. The authors demonstrated the feasibility of using an endogenous control system based on the mammalian beta-actin gene region, which could enhance diagnostic reliability. The study's findings suggest that the developed oligonucleotides may ensure detection of the majority of rabies viruses in the region, offering potential improvements for surveillance and diagnosis. However, the study is limited to theoretical and experimental design without direct validation of the system's performance in real-world scenarios, resulting in moderate confidence in the evidence.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及基于组合逆转录PCR(C-RT-PCR)的测试系统开发与优化,使用来自不同物种动物的脑样本,包括狂犬病病毒阳性与阴性样本。
elements_zh.methods: 方法包括基于俄罗斯及邻国流行狂犬病病毒分离株的193个N基因序列设计六种引物和两种TaqMan探针,优化C-RT-PCR参数,如寡核苷酸和镁离子浓度以及退火温度。还开发了一种内源性内部控制系统,用于扩增和检测哺乳动物β-肌动蛋白基因区域。
elements_zh.main_results: 对193个N基因序列的分析表明,所开发的寡核苷酸理论上可确保检测俄罗斯联邦及邻国广泛流行的大多数病毒。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为证明在C-RT-PCR中使用内源性控制检测狂犬病病毒的可行性,这代表了一种提高诊断可靠性的新方法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为开发更准确、可靠的狂犬病病毒 监测诊断工具提供信息,这对于公共卫生和疾病控制工作至关重要。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于理论设计和优化,未对测试系统的性能进行直接实验验证。证据强度中等,因为它基于序列分析和方法潜力的实验演示。

analysis_en.methods: The methods included the design of six primers and two TaqMan probes based on 193 N-gene sequences of rabies virus isolates, optimization of C-RT-PCR parameters such as oligonucleotide and magnesium ion concentrations, and annealing temperature. An endogenous internal control system was also developed for amplification and detection of the mammalian beta-actin gene region.
analysis_en.main_results: Analysis of 193 N-gene sequences showed that the developed oligonucleotides can theoretically ensure detection of the vast majority of the viruses circulating in the Russian Federation and neighboring countries.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as demonstrating the feasibility of using an endogenous control in C-RT-PCR for rabies virus detection, which represents a novel approach to improving diagnostic reliability.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of more accurate and reliable diagnostic tools for rabies virus surveillance, which is critical for public health and disease control efforts.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to theoretical design and optimization, with no direct experimental validation of the test system's performance. The evidence is moderate as it is based on sequence analysis and experimental demonstration of the method's potential.

title_zh: 基于实时PCR内源性控制的狂犬病病毒 基因组检测测试系统开发:理论设计与优化
source_body_en: Although rabies incidence in Russia has decreased over the past ten years, it still remains a highly relevant disease. Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) in its various modifications is one of the tools for detecting and characterizing rabies virus in pathological samples. To ensure reliable diagnosis, the current data on genetic properties of the isolates circulating in particular area should be considered when developing PCR. Providing a theoretical foundation and optimizing the test system based on combined reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (C-RT-PCR) for the detection of a rabies virus genome fragment using endogenous internal control. Materials and methods. Rabies virus vaccine strain “RV-97” and laboratory fixed rabies virus strain “CVS”, brain samples from animals of various species, both rabies virus positive and negative, were used in the work. Oligonucleotide design and in silico specificity testing were performed using Primer Blast online tool. Syntol reagents (Russia) were used for C-RT-PCR. As a result of the analysis of 193 N-gene sequences of rabies virus isolates circulating in Russia and neighboring countries, six primers and two TaqMan probes were designed. Two primers and a probe, optimal for the development of the test system, were experimentally identified. During a series of experiments, C-RT-PCR parameters such as oligonucleotide and magnesium ion concentrations, as well as annealing temperature were optimized. To control the reaction conditions in each tube, an oligonucleotide system was developed for the amplification and detection of the mammalian beta-actin gene region. The possibility of simultaneous application of two PCR systems in one test tube has been experimentally demonstrated. Analysis of 193 N-gene sequences of various rabies virus isolates showed that the developed oligonucleotides can theoretically ensure detection of the vast majority of the viruses circulating in the Russian Federation and neighboring countries. The main components and reaction conditions of the test system for detecting the rabies virus genome by C-RT-PCR using mammalian beta-actin gene-based endogenous internal control have been developed and optimized.
abstract_zh: 尽管在过去十年中,狂犬病 发病率在俄罗斯的发病率有所下降,但该疾病仍具有高度相关性。聚合酶链式反应(PCR)的各种改良形式是检测和表征病理样本中狂犬病病毒的一种工具。为确保可靠的诊断,开发PCR时应考虑特定地区流行狂犬病病毒分离株的遗传特性。基于组合逆转录PCR(C-RT-PCR)提供理论基础并优化检测狂犬病病毒 基因组片段的测试系统,使用内源性内部控制。材料与方法。本研究使用了狂犬病病毒“RV-97”株和实验室固定狂犬病病毒“CVS”株,以及来自不同物种动物的脑样本,包括狂犬病病毒阳性与阴性样本。使用Primer Blast在线工具进行寡核苷酸设计和计算机模拟特异性测试。C-RT-PCR使用Syntol试剂(俄罗斯)。通过对俄罗斯及邻国流行狂犬病病毒分离株的193个N基因序列进行分析,设计了六种引物和两种TaqMan探针。实验确定了两种引物和一种探针,适用于测试系统的开发。在一系列实验中,优化了C-RT-PCR参数,包括寡核苷酸和镁离子浓度,以及退火温度。为控制每管反应条件,开发了一种寡核苷酸系统用于扩增和检测哺乳动物β-肌动蛋白基因区域。实验已证明两种PCR系统可同时应用于同一测试管中。对193个不同狂犬病病毒分离株的N基因序列分析表明,所开发的寡核苷酸理论上可确保检测俄罗斯联邦及邻国广泛流行的大多数病毒。基于哺乳动物β-肌动蛋白基因的内源性内部控制,开发并优化了用于检测狂犬病病毒 基因组的测试系统的主成分和反应条件。
summary_zh: 尽管在过去十年中,狂犬病 发病率在俄罗斯的发病率有所下降,但该疾病仍具有高度相关性。聚合酶链式反应(PCR)的各种改良形式是检测和表征病理样本中狂犬病病毒的一种工具。为确保可靠的诊断,开发PCR时应考虑特定地区流行狂犬病病毒分离株的遗传特性。基于组合逆转录PCR(C-RT-PCR)提供理论基础并优化检测狂犬病病毒 基因组片段的测试系统,使用内源性内部控制。材料与方法。本研究使用了狂犬病病毒“RV-97”株和实验室固定狂犬病病毒“CVS”株,以及来自不同物种动物的脑样本,包括狂犬病病毒阳性与阴性样本。使用Primer Blast在线工具进行寡核苷酸设计和计算机模拟特异性测试。C-RT-PCR使用Syntol试剂(俄罗斯)。通过对俄罗斯及邻国流行狂犬病病毒分离株的193个N基因序列进行分析,设计了六种引物和两种TaqMan探针。实验确定了两种引物和一种探针,适用于测试系统的开发。在一系列实验中,优化了C-RT-PCR参数,包括寡核苷酸和镁离子浓度,以及退火温度。为控制每管反应条件,开发了一种寡核苷酸系统用于扩增和检测哺乳动物β-肌动蛋白基因区域。实验已证明两种PCR系统可同时应用于同一测试管中。对193个不同狂犬病病毒分离株的N基因序列分析表明,所开发的寡核苷酸理论上可确保检测俄罗斯联邦及邻国广泛流行的大多数病毒。基于哺乳动物β-肌动蛋白基因的内源性内部控制,开发并优化了用于检测狂犬病病毒 基因组的测试系统的主成分和反应条件。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在开发一种可靠的测试系统,用于通过实时PCR结合内源性控制检测狂犬病病毒 基因组,以应对改善狂犬病 监测诊断方法的需求。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及基于组合逆转录PCR(C-RT-PCR)的测试系统开发与优化,使用来自不同物种动物的脑样本,包括狂犬病病毒阳性与阴性样本。
analysis_zh.methods: 方法包括基于俄罗斯及邻国流行狂犬病病毒分离株的193个N基因序列设计六种引物和两种TaqMan探针,优化C-RT-PCR参数,如寡核苷酸和镁离子浓度以及退火温度。还开发了一种内源性内部控制系统,用于扩增和检测哺乳动物β-肌动蛋白基因区域。
analysis_zh.main_results: 对193个N基因序列的分析表明,所开发的寡核苷酸理论上可确保检测俄罗斯联邦及邻国广泛流行的大多数病毒。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为证明在C-RT-PCR中使用内源性控制检测狂犬病病毒的可行性,这代表了一种提高诊断可靠性的新方法。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为开发更准确、可靠的狂犬病病毒 监测诊断工具提供信息,这对于公共卫生和疾病控制工作至关重要。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于理论设计和优化,未对测试系统的性能进行直接实验验证。证据强度中等,因为它基于序列分析和方法潜力的实验演示。

title: Factors Associated with the Occurrence of Human Rabies Cases in Mali, 2018-2022
abstract: Introduction : Rabies is transmitted by the saliva of infected animals on excoriated skin or mucous membranes. Data from the epidemiological surveillance sub-directorate of the General Directorate of Health and Public Hygiene show an upsurge in cases of human rabies from 3 in 2020 to 10 in 2022 and dog bites from 742 in 2020 to 1702 in 2022, hence this study with the objective of studying the factors associated with the occurrence of the disease in Mali. Methods: This is an analytical cross-sectional study of data from 2018 to 2022, that took place from February 1 to September 30, 2023. Study population was made up of any suspected case of dog of rabies recorded in the DGSHP database from 2018 to 2022. Pearson or Fisher Chi 2 tests and a α cut-off of 0.05 allowed comparisons. Results : Cases of dog bites were 368 including 24 cases of human rabies, i.e. a frequency of 6.52%. Factors associated with rabies were: lesion severity (p = 0.0001), lack of lesion management (p = 0.0001), failure to clean lesions (p = 0.0001), failure to visit a health facility after the bite (p = 0.001), lack of post-exposure vaccination (p = 0.001), notification structure (p = 0.001), lack of rabies vaccination of biting dogs (p = 0.008), bite lesions (p = 0.039). Conclusion: Vaccination of dogs, adequate care and community awareness will reduce the occurrence of rabies.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究确定了导致狂犬病发生的关键因素,如暴露后护理不足和缺乏疫苗接种,这些发现可为制定针对性干预措施以减少狂犬病 发病率提供依据。

title_zh: 马里2018-2022年人类狂犬病病例相关因素分析

abstract_zh: 引言:狂犬病通过感染动物的唾液传播至破损的皮肤或黏膜。马里卫生与公共卫生总署流行病学监测分署的数据表明,2020年至2022年间人类狂犬病病例从3例增加到10例,狗咬事件从742例增加到1702例,因此本研究旨在探讨该疾病在马里的发生因素。方法:本研究为分析性横断面研究,数据来自2018年至2022年,研究时间从2023年2月1日至9月30日。研究对象为2018年至2022年间在DGSHP数据库中记录的任何疑似狗狂犬病病例。采用Pearson或Fisher Chi 2检验,显著性水平为α = 0.05进行比较。结果:共记录了368例狗咬事件,其中24例导致人类狂犬病,即发生率为6.52%。与狂犬病发生相关的因素包括:伤口严重程度(p = 0.0001)、缺乏伤口处理(p = 0.0001)、未清洁伤口(p = 0.0001)、咬伤后未前往医疗机构(p = 0.001)、缺乏暴露后疫苗接种(p = 0.001)、通报机制(p = 0.001)、咬人狗缺乏狂犬病 疫苗接种(p = 0.008)、咬伤部位(p = 0.039)。结论:狗的疫苗接种、适当的护理以及社区意识的提高将有助于减少狂犬病的发生。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查2018年至2022年间马里人类狂犬病病例的相关因素,以应对卫生与公共卫生总署流行病学监测分署报告的病例和狗咬事件的上升趋势。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究于2023年2月1日至9月30日进行,采用分析性横断面研究设计,基于2018年至2022年的数据,重点关注在DGSHP数据库中记录的疑似狗狂犬病病例。
analysis_zh.methods: 采用Pearson或Fisher Chi 2检验对数据进行分析,显著性水平设定为α = 0.05,以比较与狂犬病发生相关的因素。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在368例狗咬事件中,有24例导致人类狂犬病,发生率为6.52%。与狂犬病发生显著相关的因素包括伤口严重程度、缺乏伤口处理、未清洁伤口、咬伤后未前往医疗机构、缺乏暴露后疫苗接种、通报机制以及咬人狗缺乏狂犬病 疫苗接种。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究确定了导致狂犬病发生的关键因素,如暴露后护理不足和缺乏疫苗接种,这些发现可为制定针对性干预措施以减少狂犬病 发病率提供依据。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可指导公共卫生策略,包括疫苗接种项目和社区教育,以预防狂犬病 传播并减轻该疾病在马里的负担。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究受限于横断面设计,无法确定因果关系,且依赖于自我报告数据,可能引入偏倚。证据强度为中等。

title: Integrated bite case management within a One Health framework for rabies elimination at the primary care level in Kerala, India: an implementation research protocol using a stepped-wedge cluster randomised design.
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Rabies remains a persistent public health threat in India, while gaps in surveillance and coordination of control measures undermine progress towards ending human rabies deaths. The WHO advocates a One Health approach, combining mass dog vaccination, postexposure prophylaxis (PEP) and Integrated Bite Case Management (IBCM). IBCM is not yet incorporated into India's national rabies action plan for rabies elimination. This study seeks to generate robust evidence on the effectiveness, cost-effectiveness, feasibility, facilitators and barriers of IBCM implemented within Kerala's Rabies Control Programme. METHODS AND ANALYSIS: This implementation research adopts a stepped-wedge cluster randomised controlled trial (RCT) design. IBCM will be implemented across six administrative blocks in Thiruvananthapuram District, Kerala, across diverse rural and urban settings and including tribal population representation. The IBCM intervention includes stakeholder training and support and active animal surveillance aligned with WHO guidance. Suspect or probable rabies exposures presenting at selected health facilities will be identified via a community-based hotline. This will trigger investigations and responses including dog vaccination and sensitisation. Prior to IBCM implementation, baseline data will be collected on management of dog bites, bite patient incidence and healthcare seeking behaviours. Hospital-based event tracking of bite cases will be conducted at enrolled public health facilities before and during IBCM implementation. The resulting RCT data will be used to model the impacts and cost-effectiveness of IBCM, including the potential for cost savings through judicious PEP if scaled across Kerala. To understand the barriers and facilitators to IBCM implementation, we will use in-depth interviews and focus group discussions with stakeholders.There is an urgent need to strengthen rabies surveillance, including coordination across health and animal health sectors and outbreak responses to accelerate rabies elimination. IBCM is expected to lead to improved PEP completion, increased detection and laboratory confirmation of rabid dogs, strengthened dog vaccination coverage and targeted outbreak responses in high-risk areas. This RCT will provide critical evidence to inform policy, support scale-up, generate insights into contextual barriers and facilitators for IBCM implementation, and guide India's One Health rabies elimination strategy. This study will evaluate a health-sector-initiated IBCM approach that identifies cases through dog-bite patients presenting to health facilities, supporting comprehensive One Health integration and improved patient care. ETHICS AND DISSEMINATION: The study was approved by WHO Ethics Committee (2024.9.Ind), Kerala University of Health Sciences (AX04/SOP07A/V2) and the ethics committee of Government Medical College, Thiruvananthapuram (HEC No.12/06/2024/MCT); informed written consent will be obtained from all participants, analysis will be limited to de-identified data, and findings will be disseminated through peer-reviewed publications and policy-relevant platforms. TRIAL REGISTRATION NUMBER: CTRI/2024/08/073117.

abstract_zh: INTRODUCTION: 狂犬病在印度仍然是一个持续的公共卫生威胁,而监测方面的空白以及控制措施的协调不足阻碍了消除人类狂犬病死亡的进展。世界卫生组织倡导一种One Health方法,结合大规模犬只疫苗接种、暴露后预防(PEP)和整合犬咬伤病例管理(IBCM)。IBCM尚未纳入印度国家狂犬病消除行动计划。本研究旨在生成关于在喀拉拉邦狂犬病控制计划中实施IBCM的有效性、成本效益、可行性、促进因素和障碍的有力证据。METHODS AND ANALYSIS: 本实施研究采用阶梯楔形集群随机对照试验(RCT)设计。IBCM将在喀拉拉邦Thiruvananthapuram区的六个行政区块中实施,涵盖多样化的农村和城市环境,并包括部落人口的代表性。IBCM干预措施包括对利益相关者的培训和支持,以及符合世界卫生组织指导方针的主动动物监测。在选定的卫生机构中,通过基于社区的热线识别疑似或可能的狂犬病暴露病例。这将触发调查和响应,包括犬只疫苗接种和宣传教育。在IBCM实施之前,将收集有关犬咬伤管理、咬伤患者发病率和卫生寻求行为的基线数据。在IBCM实施前后,将在注册的公共卫生机构中进行医院事件追踪。由此产生的RCT数据将用于建模IBCM的影响和成本效益,包括在喀拉拉邦大规模实施时通过合理使用PEP实现成本节约的潜力。为了了解IBCM实施的障碍和促进因素,我们将对利益相关者进行深入访谈和焦点小组讨论。迫切需要加强狂犬病的监测,包括跨卫生和动物卫生部门的协调以及暴发响应,以加速狂犬病的消除。IBCM预计能够提高PEP完成率,增加狂犬病犬的检测和实验室确认,加强犬只疫苗接种的覆盖率,并在高风险地区实施有针对性的暴发响应。本RCT将提供关键证据,以指导政策、支持扩大实施、产生关于IBCM实施的上下文障碍和促进因素的见解,并引导印度的One Health狂犬病消除战略。本研究将评估一种由卫生部门发起的IBCM方法,通过识别前往卫生机构的犬咬伤患者来发现病例,支持全面的One Health整合和改善患者护理。ETHICS AND DISSEMINATION: 本研究已获得世界卫生组织伦理委员会(2024.9.Ind)、喀拉拉邦健康科学大学(AX04/SOP07A/V2)以及Thiruvananthapuram政府医学院伦理委员会(HEC No.12/06/2024/MCT)的批准;将从所有参与者处获得书面知情同意,分析将仅限于去标识化数据,研究结果将通过同行评审的出版物和相关政策平台进行传播。TRIAL REGISTRATION NUMBER: CTRI/2024/08/073117.

title: Knowledge, attitudes, and preventive behaviors toward rabies among urban residents in Bangkok, Thailand: Implications for targeted One Health rabies elimination strategies
abstract: Background and Aim: Rabies remains a fatal zoonotic disease and an important public health concern despite substantial reductions in human cases in Thailand. Continued circulation of rabies among animal populations highlights the need to strengthen public awareness and preventive behaviors. This study aimed to assess knowledge, attitudes, and preventive behaviors regarding rabies among Bangkok residents, identify sociodemographic factors associated with these outcomes, and examine relationships among knowledge, attitudes, and preventive behaviors to support urban rabies prevention and control strategies. Materials and Methods: A cross-sectional online survey was conducted among Bangkok residents between December 2024 and August 2025 using a structured, content-validated questionnaire. Of 262 respondents, 258 met the eligibility criteria and were included in the analysis. Descriptive statistics summarized participant characteristics and knowledge, attitudes, and preventive behaviors. Binary logistic regression identified factors associated with these domains, while Pearson’s chi-square test evaluated associations among knowledge, attitudes, and preventive behaviors. Results: Overall, 58.9% of participants demonstrated sufficient knowledge, whereas attitudes and preventive behaviors were generally favorable. Correct responses were highest for rabies transmission (97.7%), clinical signs in dogs (98.8%), and animal vaccination (96.9%), whereas only 36.1% correctly identified the recommended observation period following a bite incident. Participation in rabies awareness activities was limited (26.7%), although 73.6% reported routine pet rabies vaccination. Multivariable logistic regression showed that private sector employees were less likely to demonstrate sufficient knowledge (adjusted odds ratio [AOR] = 0.268, 95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.148-0.483; p < 0.001) and positive attitudes (AOR = 0.337, 95% CI: 0.186-0.610; p < 0.001) than students/unemployed participants. Participants aged 26-40 years had lower odds of appropriate preventive behaviors (AOR = 0.338, 95% CI: 0.173-0.657; p = 0.001), whereas participants whose pets had received rabies vaccination were more likely to report appropriate preventive behaviors (AOR = 2.512, 95% CI: 1.413-4.465; p = 0.002). Significant positive associations were identified between knowledge and attitudes and between knowledge and preventive behaviors (both p < 0.001). Conclusion: Although participants generally demonstrated favorable rabies-related knowledge, attitudes, and preventive behaviors, important gaps persisted regarding post-bite animal observation and participation in rabies awareness activities. Occupation and age were important determinants of knowledge, attitudes, and preventive behaviors, while responsible pet vaccination was positively associated with preventive practices. These findings support targeted, culturally appropriate educational interventions, workplace- and community-based awareness programs, and stronger One Health collaboration to advance urban rabies prevention and support Thailand’s progress toward the WHO “Zero by 30” rabies elimination goal. Keywords: Bangkok, knowledge, One Health, preventive behaviors, rabies, public awareness, Thailand, urban rabies control.

title: Footprint metabolomic profile shift of Sf9 insect cell line throughout growth and rabies VLP production.
abstract: Abstract The baculovirus/insect cell system is widely used for recombinant protein and virus-like particles (VLP) production, but its performance at high cell density is limited by infection-associated metabolic stress. In this study, a targeted metabolic footprinting approach was applied to characterize the extracellular metabolome of Spodoptera frugiperda Sf9 cells during baculovirus-mediated production of rabies VLP in chemically defined medium. Infected and uninfected cultures were cultivated in controlled bioreactor runs, and extracellular carbohydrates, amino acids, organic acids, and nucleosides were quantified by HPLC and LC-MS/MS. Metabolite data were converted into specific uptake and release rates, then also analyzed using Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Partial Least Squares Discriminant Analysis (PLS-DA), and Variable Importance in Projection scoring (VIP). Infection induced marked metabolic reprogramming, with increased glucose demand, dynamic shifts in amino acid consumption and release, and altered extracellular profiles over time. Although infected and control samples partially overlapped in PCA, supervised analysis improved group discrimination and identified sucrose, leucine, lysine, glycine, and pyruvate as the main variables associated with infection. Sequence-based compositional analysis of the recombinant proteins supported the relevance of amino acid-related metabolic changes, while transmission electron microscopy confirmed successful formation of rabies VLP with expected morphology. Together, these results provide a quantitative description of the metabolic burden imposed by rabies VLP production in Sf9 cells and highlight candidate metabolites for medium redesign and targeted feeding strategies to reduce the cell density effect and improve process productivity in baculovirus-based VLP manufacturing.

title_zh: Sf9昆虫细胞系在生长过程中及狂犬病病毒样颗粒(VLP)生产期间的代谢组学特征变化
source_body_en: Abstract The baculovirus/insect cell system is widely used for recombinant protein and virus-like particles (VLP) production, but its performance at high cell density is limited by infection-associated metabolic stress. abstract_zh: 摘要:杆状病毒/昆虫细胞系统广泛用于重组蛋白和病毒样颗粒(VLP)的生产,但其在高细胞密度下的性能受到感染相关代谢应激的限制。本研究采用靶向代谢足迹分析方法,以化学定义培养基中杆状病毒介导的狂犬病 VLP生产为背景,表征Spodoptera frugiperda Sf9细胞的胞外代谢组。感染和未感染的培养物在受控的生物反应器运行中培养,胞外的碳水化合物、氨基酸、有机酸和核苷被通过高效液相色谱(HPLC)和液相色谱-质谱联用技术(LC-MS/MS)进行定量分析。代谢物数据被转换为特定的摄取和释放速率,并通过主成分分析(PCA)、偏最小二乘判别分析(PLS-DA)和投影重要性评分(VIP)进行分析。感染导致显著的代谢重编程,表现为葡萄糖需求增加、氨基酸消耗和释放的动态变化以及胞外代谢物谱随时间的变化。尽管感染样本和对照样本在PCA中部分重叠,但监督分析提高了组间区分度,并确定了蔗糖、亮氨酸、赖氨酸、甘氨酸和丙酮酸为主要与感染相关的变量。重组蛋白的序列分析支持了与氨基酸相关的代谢变化的相关性,而传播电子显微镜确认了成功形成具有预期形态的狂犬病 VLP。综上所述,这些结果提供了Sf9细胞中狂犬病 VLP生产所施加的代谢负担的定量描述,并突出了可用于培养基重新设计和靶向补给策略的候选代谢物,以减少细胞密度效应并提高基于杆状病毒的VLP制造过程的生产效率。

title: Effectiveness of community-based delivery of mass dog vaccination to prevent rabies: A cluster randomized controlled trial.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Approximately 60,000 people die from rabies annually, mostly in Africa and Asia. Mass dog vaccination is critical for elimination. Herd immunity has been calculated to be attained when >40% (critical threshold) of dogs are vaccinated. A common delivery method implemented in Tanzania and other countries typically involves non-local teams travelling to villages implementing dog vaccination annually through static-point clinics using cold chain stored vaccines (Team-based delivery). Determination that a canine rabies vaccine is thermotolerant enables novel Community-based dog vaccination strategies whereby community vaccinators use vaccines stored locally throughout the year (Community-based delivery). METHODS: Two dog vaccination strategies were compared using a three-year cluster randomized controlled trial in Tanzania (Clinical Trials Registration Number ISRCTN14813279). The strategies were designed to represent implementation using resources typical of government-led initiatives. Wards (n = 112) were randomly assigned to either Team-based delivery or Community-based delivery. Coverage was estimated using household surveys implemented biannually. FINDINGS: Mean coverage achieved by Community-based delivery (55%; 95% Confidence Interval (CI): 45-65%) was higher than Team-based delivery (37%; 95% CI: 28-46%). Moreover, because coverage was lower and declined over each year only in Team-based delivery, the probability of coverage being below the critical threshold was higher for Team-based delivery (60%) compared to Community-based delivery (18%). To ensure coverage does not dip below the critical threshold by the year end, coverage at the start of the year in Team-based delivery needed to be higher (61%) than in Community-based (42%). INTERPRETATION: Community-based delivery achieved higher and more consistent vaccination coverage across a range of settings typical of many sub-Saharan African countries. Generalisation to different sociocultural/ agroecological settings requires further evidence. Although direct evidence on impact on rabies elimination was not measured, this approach could play a role in national elimination strategies, developed for the global 'Zero by 30' strategy to end dog-mediated rabies deaths by 2030, and in response to investment by Gavi, the vaccine alliance.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Approximately 60,000 people die from rabies annually, mostly in Africa and Asia. Mass dog vaccination is critical for elimination.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Two dog vaccination strategies were compared using a three-year cluster randomized controlled trial in Tanzania. Wards (n = 112) were randomly assigned to either Team-based delivery or Community-based delivery.
analysis.methods: The strategies were designed to represent implementation using resources typical of government-led initiatives. A common delivery method implemented in Tanzania and other countries typically involves non-local teams travelling to villages implementing dog vaccination annually through static-point clinics using cold chain stored vaccines (Team-based delivery).
analysis.main_results: Mean coverage achieved by Community-based delivery (55%; 95% Confidence Interval (CI): 45-65%) was higher than Team-based delivery (37%; 95% CI: 28-46%). analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Community-based delivery achieved higher and more consistent vaccination coverage across a range of settings typical of many sub-Saharan African countries. analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that Community-based delivery could be an effective strategy for national rabies elimination efforts, particularly in sub-Saharan African countries where such methods are commonly used. analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Generalisation to different sociocultural/ agroecological settings requires further evidence. The supplied evidence does not report direct evidence on impact on rabies elimination.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the effectiveness of two community-based dog vaccination strategies in preventing rabies in Tanzania. The research aimed to determine which method could achieve higher and more consistent vaccination coverage, a critical factor for herd immunity. A cluster randomized controlled trial over three years compared Team-based delivery, involving non-local teams using cold chain stored vaccines, with Community-based delivery, where local vaccinators used vaccines stored throughout the year. The results showed that Community-based delivery achieved higher coverage (55% vs. 37%) and maintained it more consistently than Team-based delivery. The authors interpreted these findings as indicating that Community-based delivery could be a valuable strategy for rabies elimination, particularly in sub-Saharan African countries. The study's implications suggest that this method may support national and global efforts to end dog-mediated rabies deaths by 2030. However, the authors noted that further evidence is needed to generalize these results to different sociocultural and agroecological settings.

title_zh: 基于社区的群体犬 疫苗接种 用于预防 狂犬病 的有效性:一项集群随机对照试验。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Approximately 60,000 people die from rabies annually, mostly in Africa and Asia. Mass dog vaccination is critical for elimination. Herd immunity has been calculated to be attained when >40% (critical threshold) of dogs are vaccinated. A common delivery method implemented in Tanzania and other countries typically involves non-local teams travelling to villages implementing dog vaccination annually through static-point clinics using cold chain stored vaccines (Team-based delivery). Determination that a canine rabies vaccine is thermotolerant enables novel Community-based dog vaccination strategies whereby community vaccinators use vaccines stored locally throughout the year (Community-based delivery). METHODS: Two dog vaccination strategies were compared using a three-year cluster randomized controlled trial in Tanzania (Clinical Trials Registration Number ISRCTN14813279). The strategies were designed to represent implementation using resources typical of government-led initiatives. Wards (n = 112) were randomly assigned to either Team-based delivery or Community-based delivery. Coverage was estimated using household surveys implemented biannually. FINDINGS: Mean coverage achieved by Community-based delivery (55%; 95% Confidence Interval (CI): 45-65%) was higher than Team-based delivery (37%; 95% CI: 28-46%). Moreover, because coverage was lower and declined over each year only in Team-based delivery, the probability of coverage being below the critical threshold was higher for Team-based delivery (60%) compared to Community-based delivery (18%). To ensure coverage does not dip below the critical threshold by the year end, coverage at the start of the year in Team-based delivery needed to be higher (61%) than in Community-based (42%). INTERPRETATION: Community-based delivery achieved higher and more consistent vaccination coverage across a range of settings typical of many sub-Saharan African countries. Generalisation to different sociocultural/ agroecological settings requires further evidence. Although direct evidence on impact on rabies elimination was not measured, this approach could play a role in national elimination strategies, developed for the global 'Zero by 30' strategy to end dog-mediated rabies deaths by 2030, and in response to investment by Gavi, the vaccine alliance.

title: Estimating total human deaths from rabies: A statistical framework leveraging reports of rabies transmission from deceased organ and tissue donors.
abstract: Estimating the global burden of human rabies is notoriously challenging because the infection is often misdiagnosed or not reported. Although rare, instances of donor-derived human-to-human rabies transmission have been identified after organ or tissue transplantation. Here, we present a statistical framework leveraging these instances to estimate both the probability that a death from rabies is diagnosed for an infected individual and the number of total deaths from rabies. Of the 33 canine-rabies-endemic and 13 canine-rabies-free countries assessed, rabies was identified among deceased donors after transplantation in China (n = 4) between 2015 and 2024 and the United States of America (US) (n = 3) between 2000 and 2024. Assuming the same proportion of deaths from rabies among deceased donors and decedents in the general population, we estimated that China and the US diagnosed rabies in only 28.7% (95%CI: 14.8-56.5%) and 6.1% (95%CI: 2.4-21.1%) of rabies decedents, respectively, during the study years. In 2024, these corresponded to 581 (95%CI: 308-1,056) and 75 (95%CI: 19-242) estimated total deaths from rabies compared to 167 and 4 reported deaths from rabies, respectively. Although parameters were imprecisely estimated for the remaining countries, for countries with a relatively large number of deceased donors, our framework provided informative upper confidence bounds on total deaths from rabies, which can inform the design of surveillance and control measures. For example, in 2023, this upper bound was estimated to be 2,227 deaths from rabies for India. Parameter estimates were sensitive to the assumed relative risk of rabies between deceased donors and decedents in the general population, highlighting the need for future research to estimate this quantity and improve inference within our framework. Our findings show substantial underreporting of human deaths from rabies in both canine-rabies-endemic and canine-rabies-free countries, underscoring the need to strengthen surveillance and diagnostic capacity and raise risk awareness.

analysis_zh.methods: 作者利用来自死亡器官和组织捐献者的狂犬病 传播报告来估算狂犬病 诊断的概率和总死亡人数。他们假设死亡捐献者和一般人群中狂犬病死亡的比例相同,以计算这些估计值。
analysis_zh.main_results: 假设在死亡捐赠者和一般人群中因狂犬病死亡的比例相同,作者估计,在研究期间,中国和美国仅分别诊断出狂犬病死亡病例的28.7%(95%CI:14.8-56.5%)和6.1%(95%CI:2.4-21.1%)。2024年,这些分别对应于581(95%CI:308-1,056)和75(95%CI:19-242)例估计的狂犬病总死亡病例,而实际报告的狂犬病死亡病例分别为167例和4例。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将他们的发现解释为表明,在犬类狂犬病流行和非流行国家中,人类狂犬病死亡的报告存在显著不足。该框架提供了一种新颖的方法,利用死亡捐献者的数据来估算狂犬病的总死亡人数。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以通过突出人类狂犬病死亡的报告不足,来为设计监测和控制措施提供信息。它们还强调了加强诊断能力和提高对狂犬病风险意识的必要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 参数估计对假设的死亡捐献者与一般人群中狂犬病的相对风险敏感,强调了未来研究需要估算这一数量。由于依赖于报告的传播病例和对诊断率的假设,证据强度中等。

title: DIAGNOSIS AND TREATMENT EXPERIENCE OF A CASE OF ACHILLES TENDON RUPTURE CAUSED BY MONKEY BITE AND LITERATURE REVIEW
abstract: Objective: To investigate the clinical characteristics, surgical repair strategies, and post-exposure rabies prophylaxis for multiple injuries to the left lower limb caused by a monkey bite (Achilles tendon rupture combined with nerve and vein rupture), and to improve the understanding of such complex injuries through a literature review. Methods: Clinical data from one patient with ruptures of the Achilles tendon, sural nerve branches, and great saphenous vein in the left lower limb due to a monkey bite were retrospectively analyzed. Relevant literature on monkey bites, Achilles tendon rupture, and infection prevention and control after animal bites was retrieved from databases including CNKI, Wanfang, and PubMed, and summarized alongside the diagnostic and therapeutic experience from this case. Results: The surgical procedures were successful. Postoperative wound dressings remained dry, and no significant redness, swelling, or exudation was observed at the wound site during dressing changes. The skin flap exhibited good blood supply, and the Achilles tendon healed well. No complications such as rabies onset or wound infection occurred. Monkey bites have a high risk of infection. Rabies remains a major concern, but B virus (Cercopithecine herpesvirus) also needs attention. When Achilles tendon rupture occurs together with nerve and vascular injury, microsurgical repair combined with individualized skin flap coverage is particularly important because it may lower infection and amputation rates. Early postoperative functional exercise also supports recovery. Standardized follow-up helps restore Achilles tendon function. Conclusion: Achilles tendon rupture caused by monkey bites is often accompanied by nerve and vascular injury, which makes treatment more difficult because tissue repair must be handled together with infection control. Postoperative rehabilitation should be carried out in a standardized way, with close follow-up to support functional recovery. The literature reviewed here helps clarify diagnosis and treatment strategies for these complex cases.
journal: Journal of Pharmaceutical and Medical Research

Methods: Clinical data from one patient with ruptures of the Achilles tendon, sural nerve branches, and great saphenous vein in the left lower limb due to a monkey bite were retrospectively analyzed. Relevant literature on monkey bites, Achilles tendon rupture, and infection prevention and control after animal bites was retrieved from databases including CNKI, Wanfang, and PubMed, and summarized alongside the diagnostic and therapeutic experience from this case. Results: The surgical procedures were successful. Postoperative wound dressings remained dry, and no significant redness, swelling, or exudation was observed at the wound site during dressing changes. The skin flap exhibited good blood supply, and the Achilles tendon healed well. No complications such as rabies onset or wound infection occurred. Monkey bites have a high risk of infection. Rabies remains a major concern, but B virus (Cercopithecine herpesvirus) also needs attention. When Achilles tendon rupture occurs together with nerve and vascular injury, microsurgical repair combined with individualized skin flap coverage is particularly important because it may lower infection and amputation rates. Early postoperative functional exercise also supports recovery. Standardized follow-up helps restore Achilles tendon function. Conclusion: Achilles tendon rupture caused by monkey bites is often accompanied by nerve and vascular injury, which makes treatment more difficult because tissue repair must be handled together with infection control. Postoperative rehabilitation should be carried out in a standardized way, with close follow-up to support functional recovery. The literature reviewed here helps clarify diagnosis and treatment strategies for these complex cases.
source_records.journal: Journal of Pharmaceutical and Medicinal Research

analysis.summary_en: This review focuses on the clinical characteristics, surgical repair strategies, and post-exposure rabies prophylaxis for multiple injuries to the left lower limb caused by a monkey bite, specifically Achilles tendon rupture combined with nerve and vein rupture. The study retrospectively analyzed clinical data from one patient and summarized relevant literature from databases such as CNKI, Wanfang, and PubMed. The key conclusions highlight the complexity of treating such injuries, emphasizing the need for combined tissue repair and infection control. It also underscores the importance of standardized postoperative rehabilitation and follow-up for functional recovery. The implications suggest that microsurgical repair with individualized skin flap coverage is critical in reducing infection and amputation rates, and that early functional exercise and follow-up are essential. Rabies remains a major concern, but B virus (Cercopithecine herpesvirus) also needs attention. The review provides valuable insights into the diagnosis and treatment of these complex cases.

title: Wild Boar-Related Injuries in Wilderness Environments: Field-Oriented Management Principles and Evidence-Informed Clinical Recommendations
abstract: Wild boar-related trauma is uncommon but may result in severe injuries that pose diagnostic and therapeutic challenges, particularly in wilderness or resource-limited environments. Most scientific literature consists of isolated case reports, regional series, and forensic descriptions; clinical guidance is therefore fragmented. This study synthesizes two complementary evidence sources: a structured observational cohort documenting 101 injuries sustained by boar hunters during organized hunts in Germany, and a comprehensive systematic review of all globally published wild boar- and feral pig-related human injuries. The observational cohort provided internally consistent epidemiologic information on who was injured, under what circumstances, how quickly assistance was obtained, and how injuries were treated and ultimately healed. The systematic review added detailed insight into injury morphology and severity across diverse settings, including reports of deep wound tracts, extensive soft-tissue disruption, significant contamination, and the risk of hemorrhage, neurovascular compromise, or thoracoabdominal penetration. The systematic review was conducted in accordance with PRISMA 2020 principles and included explicit study identification, screening, and eligibility assessment. Integrating these sources enabled a field-oriented approach to assessment and management, emphasizing early hemorrhage control, broad-spectrum antibiotic therapy, appropriate use of imaging, thorough surgical exploration when indicated, and region-specific tetanus or rabies prophylaxis. Together, these findings support clinicians working in remote or austere environments who may encounter these rare but potentially serious injuries.

Integrating these sources enabled a field-oriented approach to assessment and management, emphasizing early hemorrhage control, broad-spectrum antibiotic therapy, appropriate use of imaging, thorough surgical exploration when indicated, and region-specific tetanus or rabies prophylaxis. abstract_zh: 与野猪相关的创伤较为罕见,但可能导致严重伤害,给诊断和治疗带来挑战,尤其是在野外或资源有限的环境中。大多数科学文献仅包含孤立的病例报告、区域性系列和法医描述;因此临床指导较为零散。本研究综合了两种互补的证据来源:一项结构化的观察性研究,记录了德国组织狩猎中101名野猪猎人所受的伤害,以及一项全面的系统综述,涵盖了全球所有关于野猪和野猪相关人类伤害的出版文献。该观察性研究提供了内部一致的流行病学信息,包括谁受伤、在何种情况下受伤、获得援助的速度以及伤害的治疗和最终愈合情况。系统综述则提供了关于不同环境下伤害形态和严重程度的详细见解,包括深部伤口通道、广泛的软组织破坏、显著的污染以及出血、神经血管功能障碍或胸腹穿透的风险。系统综述遵循PRISMA 2020原则,并包含明确的研究识别、筛选和资格评估。整合这些来源使我们能够采取面向现场的评估和管理方法,强调早期出血控制、广谱抗生素治疗、适当使用影像学检查、必要时进行彻底的外科探查,以及地区特定的破伤风或暴露后预防措施。这些发现共同支持在偏远或艰苦环境中工作的临床医生,他们可能会遇到这些罕见但可能严重的伤害。

title: Knowledge Assessment of Dog Bite and Rabies Management among Health Workers in the Border Region of Timor-Leste
abstract: Objectives: Rabies emerged as a significant public health threat in Timor-Leste following the first laboratory-confirmed outbreaks in 2024. The Região Administrativa Especial de Oé-Cusse Ambeno (RAEOA) border region has been disproportionately affected, recording over 800 dog bite cases and five human deaths between 2023 and 2024. This study assessed healthcare workers’ (HCWs) knowledge of rabies transmission, prevention, and dog bite management to identify gaps and strengthen the local health response. Methods: A quantitative knowledge survey was conducted from 14 to 22 April 2024. Using convenience sampling, data was collected from 164 HCWs across seven health facilities in the RAEOA region. Descriptive statistics were presented, while inferential analysis using Analysis of Variance was performed to examine differences in knowledge scores across professional cadres and health facilities. Results: The mean age of the 164 participants was 34 years (SD 8.84). Nurses (25.6%) and allied technicians (20.1%) comprised the largest professional groups. Overall knowledge was high, with a mean score of 80%; 37.2% achieved a perfect score of 17/17. Significant differences in knowledge scores were observed by profession (p-value 0.018) and workplace (p-value 0.006), with doctors and midwives achieving the highest mean scores. However, only 40.8% of respondents correctly identified rabies’ near-100% fatality rate, and only 71.9% knew Category III wounds should not be sutured. Public Health Recommendations: HCWs in the RAEOA region demonstrated strong knowledge of rabies transmission, prevention, and management. However, disparities across professional cadres and health facilities underscore the need for targeted, continuous training, equitable resource distribution, and strengthened surveillance systems. Rabies control efforts should adopt a One Health approach integrating human health surveillance, dog vaccination, and cross-border coordination.

The Região Administrativa Especial de Oé-Cusse Ambeno (RAEOA) border region has been disproportionately affected, recording over 800 dog bite cases and five human deaths between 2023 and 2024. This study assessed healthcare workers’ (HCWs) knowledge of rabies transmission, prevention, and dog bite management to identify gaps and strengthen the local health response. Methods: A quantitative knowledge survey was conducted from 14 to 22 April 2024. Using convenience sampling, data was collected from 164 HCWs across seven health facilities in the RAEOA region. Descriptive statistics were presented, while inferential analysis using Analysis of Variance was performed to examine differences in knowledge scores across professional cadres and health facilities. Results: The mean age of the 164 participants was 34 years (SD 8.84). Nurses (25.6%) and allied technicians (20.1%) comprised the largest professional groups. Overall knowledge was high, with a mean score of 80%; 37.2% achieved a perfect score of 17/17. Significant differences in knowledge scores were observed by profession (p-value 0.018) and workplace (p-value 0.006), with doctors and midwives achieving the highest mean scores. However, only 40.8% of respondents correctly identified rabies’ near-100% fatality rate, and only 71.9% knew Category III wounds should not be sutured. Public Health Recommendations: HCWs in the RAEOA region demonstrated strong knowledge of rabies transmission, prevention, and management. However, disparities across professional cadres and health facilities underscore the need for targeted, continuous training, equitable resource distribution, and strengthened surveillance systems. Rabies control efforts should adopt a One Health approach integrating human health surveillance, dog vaccination, and cross-border coordination.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 在2024年首次实验室确认暴发后,狂犬病在东帝汶成为了一个重要的公共卫生威胁。东帝汶边境地区的Região Administrativa Especial de Oé-Cusse Ambeno(RAEOA)区域受到的影响尤为严重,2023年至2024年间记录了超过800例狗咬伤病例和5例人类死亡。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024年4月14日至22日进行了一项定量知识调查。通过方便抽样,从RAEOA地区的七个卫生机构中收集了164名HCWs的数据。研究聚焦于东帝汶边境地区的卫生工作者。
elements_zh.methods: 呈现了描述性统计,并使用方差分析(ANOVA)进行推断分析,以考察不同职业类别和卫生机构之间知识得分的差异。通过调查评估了卫生工作者对狂犬病 传播、预防和狗咬伤管理的知识。
elements_zh.main_results: 164名参与者的平均年龄为34岁(标准差8.84)。护士(25.6%)和辅助技术人员(20.1%)是最大的职业群体。总体知识水平较高,平均得分为80%;37.2%的受访者获得了满分17/17。职业(p值0.018)和工作场所(p值0.006)之间观察到知识得分的显著差异,医生和助产士的平均得分最高。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 公共卫生建议:RAEOA地区的HCWs在狂犬病 传播、预防和管理方面表现出较强的知识。不同职业类别和卫生机构之间的差异强调了需要有针对性的持续培训、公平的资源分配以及加强监测系统。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 狂犬病的控制工作应采用一种One Health方法,整合人类健康监测、狗疫苗接种以及跨境协调。研究结果突显了提高卫生工作者知识水平对于增强狂犬病预防和应对策略的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其依赖于自我报告数据和方便抽样,这可能引入偏差。证据强度中等,因为它提供了关于知识差距的见解,但并未包括直接的临床或流行病学结果。

title: A Study to Assess the Level of Knowledge regarding Prevention and Management of Rabies among Higher Secondary School Children in selected Schools of Pinarayi
abstract: Rabies is one of the oldest and deadliest disease known to man and still continues to cause significant human mortality. It is the world's deadliest disease, which has 100% fatality and at the same time 100% preventability. Kerala being the most literate state in the country, with a percentage of 96.2% literates still ignore about the urgency of first aid management of the wound after dog bite and the postexposure prophylaxis and treatment could be one of the causes contributing to the present situation of rise in rabies cases. The study used a non experimental descriptive design and was conducted among 120 samples of AKGM Govt. HSS, Pinarayi, by simple random sampling method. A structured knowledge questionnaire was used as a tool. The findings shows that there is significant association between knowledge level and socio-personal variables such as gender. The study shows that majority 77(64.16%) of samples have poor knowledge, 36(30%) have average knowledge and 7(5.83%) have good knowledge regarding prevention and management of rabies.
journal: International Journal of Science and Research (IJSR)

The study's implications suggest that targeted public health interventions in schools could help reduce rabies cases. source_body_en: Rabies is one of the oldest and deadliest disease known to man and still continues to cause significant human mortality. It is the world's deadliest disease, which has 100% fatality and at the same time 100% preventability. Kerala being the most literate state in the country, with a percentage of 96.2% literates still ignore about the urgency of first aid management of the wound after dog bite and the postexposure prophylaxis and treatment could be one of the causes contributing to the present situation of rise in rabies cases. The study used a non experimental descriptive design and was conducted among 120 samples of AKGM Govt. HSS, Pinarayi, by simple random sampling method. A structured knowledge questionnaire was used as a tool. The findings shows that there is significant association between knowledge level and socio-personal variables such as gender. The study shows that majority 77(64.16%) of samples have poor knowledge, 36(30%) have average knowledge and 7(5.83%) have good knowledge regarding prevention and management of rabies.

title: Cost-utility analysis of pre-exposure prophylaxis rabies vaccine in 5-year-old children in Thailand.
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Rabies remains a life-threatening disease affecting children in endemic regions including Thailand. The cost-effectiveness of pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) rabies vaccination in the Thai context is unclear. This study analysed the cost-utility of adding PrEP rabies vaccination to post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) rabies vaccination compared with PEP alone in 5-year-old children. METHODS: A decision tree model compared eight strategies (four PEP alone and four PrEP+PEP), classified by route of administration (intradermal (ID) or intramuscular (IM)) and vaccine product (purified chick embryo cell vaccine (PCEC) or chromatographically purified Vero cell vaccine (CPRV)/purified Vero cell rabies vaccine (PVRV)). Costs and outcomes were derived from published literature and discounted at 3% annually. The analysis was conducted from a societal perspective over a 20-year horizon. title: 5’ untranslated region (5’ UTR) of bovine β-globin in the mRNA constructs translates different types of antigenic proteins
abstract: Synthetic messenger RNA (mRNA) is emerging as next generation vaccine platform. As natural 5’UTRs of particular genes do not work for other than its own mRNA, it is essential to identify an ideal 5’UTR supporting higher translation efficiency for different antigens. Six natural 5’UTRs derived from α, β-globin genes of host animals and other viral genes were cloned upstream to the coding sequences of reporter proteins. The corresponding capped mRNA were produced through in vitro transcription and the translation efficiency was assessed using flow cytometry, bioluminescence, immunofluorescence and western blot experiments. The results revealed higher translation of reporter proteins by bovine β-globin 5’UTR in different cell lines. Further, the chosen 5’UTR supported mRNA translation to produce different antigenic proteins such as rabies virus glycoprotein (RVG), major structural protein of foot and mouth disease virus (VP1) and bacterial epsilon toxoid protein (Eptx). Bovine -globin 5’UTR not only increased the translation efficiency of reporter proteins but also supported the expression of different antigenic proteins. Hence, bovine -globin 5’UTR can be used in the mRNA vaccine designs against animal diseases.

As natural 5’UTRs of particular genes do not work for other than its own mRNA, it is essential to identify an ideal 5’UTR supporting higher translation efficiency for different antigens. Six natural 5’UTRs derived from α, β-globin genes of host animals and other viral genes were cloned upstream to the coding sequences of reporter proteins. The corresponding capped mRNA were produced through in vitro transcription and the translation efficiency was assessed using flow cytometry, bioluminescence, immunofluorescence and western blot experiments. The results revealed higher translation of reporter proteins by bovine β-globin 5’UTR in different cell lines. Further, the chosen 5’UTR supported mRNA translation to produce different antigenic proteins such as rabies virus glycoprotein (RVG), major structural protein of foot and mouth disease virus (VP1) and bacterial epsilon toxoid protein (Eptx). Bovine -globin 5’UTR not only increased the translation efficiency of reporter proteins but also supported the expression of different antigenic proteins. Hence, bovine -globin 5’UTR can be used in the mRNA vaccine designs against animal diseases.
title_original: 5’ untranslated region (5’ UTR) of bovine β-globin in the mRNA constructs translates different types of antigenic proteins

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the need for an ideal 5’UTR that supports higher translation efficiency for different antigens, as natural 5’UTRs of particular genes do not work for other than its own mRNA. This is critical for the development of next-generation mRNA vaccine platforms.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved cloning six natural 5’UTRs from α, β-globin genes of host animals and other viral genes upstream to the coding sequences of reporter proteins. The translation efficiency was assessed in different cell lines.
analysis.methods: The corresponding capped mRNA were produced through in vitro transcription, and translation efficiency was evaluated using flow cytometry, bioluminescence, immunofluorescence and western blot experiments.
analysis.main_results: The results revealed that the bovine β-globin 5’UTR significantly increased the translation efficiency of reporter proteins across different cell lines. Additionally, it supported the expression of various antigenic proteins such as rabies virus glycoprotein (RVG), major structural protein of foot and mouth disease virus (VP1) and bacterial epsilon toxoid protein (Eptx).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these findings as evidence that the bovine β-globin 5’UTR can be effectively used in mRNA vaccine designs against animal diseases, highlighting its versatility in supporting translation of different antigenic proteins.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of more effective mRNA vaccines for animal diseases, particularly those targeting rabies virus and related pathogens, by providing a reliable 5’UTR that enhances translation efficiency.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro assessments and does not include in vivo validation, which may affect the generalizability of the findings. However, the results are supported by multiple experimental methods, providing moderate confidence in the effectiveness of the bovine β-globin 5’UTR.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the potential of the bovine β-globin 5’UTR as a universal mRNA translation enhancer for different antigens. The research aimed to address the challenge of finding an effective 5’UTR for mRNA vaccine development, as natural 5’UTRs are gene-specific. The study involved cloning six natural 5’UTRs upstream to reporter proteins and assessing their translation efficiency in vitro. Results showed that the bovine β-globin 5’UTR significantly enhanced translation across various cell lines and supported the expression of different antigenic proteins, including rabies virus glycoprotein (RVG), foot and mouth disease virus (VP1), and bacterial epsilon toxoid protein (Eptx). The authors interpreted these findings as evidence that the bovine β-globin 5’UTR could be used in mRNA vaccine designs against animal diseases. The study's in vitro nature limits its generalizability, but the results are supported by multiple experimental methods, providing moderate confidence in the effectiveness of the 5’UTR. These findings have implications for improving mRNA vaccine platforms for animal diseases, particularly rabies.

abstract_zh: 合成信使 RNA (mRNA) 正在成为下一代 疫苗 平台。由于特定基因的天然 5'UTR 只能作用于其自身的 mRNA,因此有必要确定一个理想的 5'UTR,以支持不同抗原的更高翻译效率。来自 宿主 动物的 α、β-球蛋白基因和其他病毒基因的 6 个天然 5'UTR 被克隆到报告蛋白编码序列的上游。通过体外转录产生相应的加帽mRNA,并使用流式细胞术、生物发光、免疫荧光和蛋白质印迹实验评估翻译效率。结果表明,牛 β-珠蛋白 5'UTR 在不同细胞系中对报告蛋白的翻译更高。此外,所选的5'UTR支持mRNA翻译以产生不同的抗原蛋白,例如狂犬病病毒糖蛋白(RVG)、口蹄疫病毒(VP1)的主要结构蛋白和细菌ε类毒素蛋白(Eptx)。牛珠蛋白5'UTR不仅提高了报告蛋白的翻译效率,而且支持不同抗原蛋白的表达。因此,牛珠蛋白 5'UTR 可用于针对动物疾病的 mRNA 疫苗 设计。

analysis.research_question_and_background: Rabies remains a major global public health concern due to its high fatality rate and the need for expanded surveillance, particularly in atypical hosts such as Cape fur seals.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focused on rabies in Cape fur seals, highlighting the need to understand the expanded host range of the rabies virus and its implications for public health surveillance.
analysis.methods: The study involved examining rabies cases in Cape fur seals, with an emphasis on identifying the virus's presence and characteristics in these atypical hosts.
analysis.main_results: The study confirmed the presence of rabies virus in Cape fur seals, indicating an expanded host range and underscoring the importance of monitoring such hosts for rabies outbreaks.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that rabies virus can infect atypical hosts like Cape fur seals, which has implications for understanding the virus's ecology and improving surveillance strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study informs the need for broader surveillance of rabies in marine mammals and highlights the importance of considering non-traditional hosts in public health preparedness.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's evidence is based on observations of rabies in Cape fur seals, which may have limited generalizability to other host species, and the confidence in these findings is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study highlights the presence of rabies virus in Cape fur seals, an atypical host, which expands the known host range of the virus and emphasizes the need for enhanced surveillance. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于其高死亡率和需要扩大监测,狂犬病仍然是全球主要的公共卫生问题,特别是在南非海豹等非典型宿主中。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究聚焦于南非海豹中的狂犬病,强调了理解狂犬病病毒在非典型宿主中的扩展范围及其对公共卫生监测的影响的重要性。

elements_zh.main_results: 本研究确认了狂犬病病毒在南非海豹中的存在,表明该病毒的范围已扩展,并强调了对这类非典型宿主进行监测以应对狂犬病 暴发的重要性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,狂犬病病毒可以感染如南非海豹等非典型宿主,这对理解病毒的生态学以及改进监测策略具有重要意义。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 本研究强调了在海洋哺乳动物中扩大监测对狂犬病的必要性,并突出了在公共卫生准备中考虑非传统宿主的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的证据基于对南非海豹中狂犬病的观察,可能无法推广到其他宿主物种,且这些发现的可信度中等。

title: Potential for real-time health and welfare monitoring of red fox (Vulpes vulpes) in experimental settings using implants
abstract: Monitoring and improving animal health and welfare is a pressing need. Technological advances are increasing our ability to do so in a range of settings but there are limited uses in experimental settings for less common model animals. Red foxes ( Vulpes vulpes ) are maintained by the French National Agency for Food, Environmental, and Occupational Health and Safety (ANSES) for regulatory and research purposes, primarily related to its role as a European Union and French Reference Laboratory for rabies and Echinococcus spp., both serious zoonoses. In 2022, four foxes were surgically fitted with internal implants that recorded body temperature and activity levels and subsequently inoculated with rabies virus (RABV). As a proof of concept, we retrospectively tested the potential of these two variables to provide an early warning for the onset of rabies symptoms. To do so, we applied two anomaly detection algorithms (Shewhart and EWMA) with varying confidence levels individually to the two data sets from each fox and compared how early the different models could detect significant changes while limiting false alarms during the calibration period. We found that all the foxes significantly changed their activity during infection. We were best able to detect these changes at the individual fox level using the EWMA algorithm, in some cases producing consecutive alarms up to two weeks before the death of an animal, while limiting false alarms. We found no evidence of fever in any of the infected foxes and body temperature did not appear to be a reliable indicator of foxes’ health in this context. While here we applied our methods to a particularly severe and rarely implemented model with a limited sample size, this proof of concept illustrates the potential of these methods for a wide range of other situations that would benefit from similar long-term monitoring, including experimental protocols with milder clinical signs and routine monitoring for unexpected declines in health or welfare.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the potential of using internal implants to monitor health and welfare in red foxes (Vulpes vulpes) in experimental settings, focusing on rabies virus (RABV) infection. The research aimed to test the ability of body temperature and activity levels to serve as early warning indicators for rabies symptoms. Four foxes were implanted with devices that recorded these variables and then inoculated with RABV. The study applied two anomaly detection algorithms (Shewhart and EWMA) to the data sets to assess their effectiveness in detecting changes before the onset of symptoms. Results showed that activity levels changed significantly during infection, while body temperature did not appear to be a reliable indicator. The EWMA algorithm was most effective in detecting these changes early, with some alarms occurring up to two weeks before death. The study highlights the potential of these methods for broader applications in health monitoring, particularly for animals with milder clinical signs. However, the findings are limited by the small sample size and retrospective analysis.

abstract_zh: 监测和改善动物健康与福利是一项紧迫的需求。技术进步正在增强我们在各种环境中的能力,但在实验环境中,对于不太常见的模型动物的应用仍有限。红狐(Vulpes vulpes)由法国国家食品安全、环境与职业健康与安全局(ANSES)用于监管和研究目的,主要与其作为欧洲联盟和法国人兽共患病参考实验室的角色相关,该实验室涉及狂犬病和Echinococcus spp.,这两种都是严重的人兽共患病。2022年,四只红狐被外科手术植入了可记录体温和活动水平的内部装置,并随后接种了狂犬病病毒(RABV)。作为概念验证,我们回顾性地测试了这两个变量在预测狂犬病症状出现方面的潜力。为此,我们分别将两种异常检测算法(Shewhart和EWMA)应用于每只红狐的两个数据集,并在校准期间比较这些模型在检测显著变化方面能提前多久,同时限制误报。我们发现,所有红狐在感染期间都显著改变了其活动水平。在个体红狐层面,我们发现EWMA算法最能检测到这些变化,某些情况下甚至能在动物死亡前两周连续发出警报,同时限制误报。我们未发现任何感染红狐出现发热的证据,且体温似乎在此情境下不是红狐健康状况的可靠指标。尽管我们在这里将方法应用于一个特别严重且很少实施的模型,且样本量有限,但这一概念验证展示了这些方法在需要类似长期监测的广泛其他情境中的潜力,包括临床症状较轻的实验方案以及对健康或福利意外下降的常规监测。

title: EPIDEMIOLOGICAL PROFILE OF COMPULSORY NOTIFICATIONS OF HUMAN ANTIRABIES CARE IN PORTO NACIONAL, TOCANTINS, BRAZIL
abstract: This study aimed to analyze the epidemiological profile of compulsory notifications related to human anti-rabies care in the municipality of Porto Nacional, Tocantins, Brazil, from 2015 to 2025. This was an observational, descriptive, retrospective, quantitative, and censusbased study using notification data provided by the Municipal Health Surveillance Department. A total of 5,813 records were analyzed, considering sociodemographic variables, characteristics of exposure, prophylactic management, number of recorded vaccine doses, and temporal distribution. The results showed a predominance of males, individuals aged 1 to 19 years, and residents of urban areas. Bites were the main type of exposure, with dogs being the animals most frequently involved. Lower limbs, hands, and feet showed the highest frequencies regarding injury location. Animal observation was the most frequently recommended management, and a high frequency of records without registered vaccine doses was observed. The temporal distribution showed fluctuations, with an increase in attendances during the final years of the study period and the highest number of records in 2025. It is concluded that these findings may support surveillance, prevention, and health education actions.
